construction.flecnode_condition: a point is flecnodal if the three homogeneous equations in v have a nonzero projective solution
construction.second_contact: D_v^2 F=0 using Hasse derivatives in positive characteristic
construction.surface: let F(x,y,z) be a squarefree irreducible polynomial of degree d defining a component
construction.third_contact: D_v^3 F=0 using Hasse derivatives, valid under the imported degree

contained_line.consequence: every contained line lies in Z(F) cap Z(Flec(F)) outside harmless singular/exceptional points
contained_line.downstream_use: if Flec(F) is not identically zero on F, Bezout with deg Flec(F)=O(d) gives the O(d^3) non-ruled line-intersection scale after the remaining Cayley-Salmon criterion
contained_line.reason: restricting F to ell gives the zero univariate polynomial, so the first three Hasse directional derivatives along ell vanish
contained_line.statement: if an affine/projective line ell is contained in Z(F), then every nonsingular point of ell is flecnodal

elimination.classical_sharpening: the classical Salmon flecnode polynomial has degree 11d-24; the internal chain only needs O(d)
elimination.coefficient_degrees: the three contact equations have direction degrees 1,2,3 and x-degrees d-1,d-2,d-3
elimination.method: take the multihomogeneous resultant in the projective direction variables
elimination.result: obtain a polynomial Flec(F)(x,y,z) vanishing at every flecnodal point of F=0
elimination.safe_degree_bound: deg Flec(F)<=11d is enough for all downstream Bezout estimates

plain_conclusion: 当前唯一内部自足线继续下钻并关闭一个真实结构原子：flecnode 多项式的构造与次数界。用一、二、三阶 Hasse 方向导数写出三阶接触条件，再对 projective 方向变量消元，得到 Flec(F)；安全次数界 deg Flec(F)<=11d 已足以支撑后续 Bezout。任何包含于 F=0 的直线都会落入 flecnode locus。但 Cayley-Salmon 判据和 singly-ruled 的 ruling/异常线几何仍未内联，所以 row_column_unconditional_closed 仍保持 false。
